Stop accounting, scoped to attempt windows (device clock, before.json -> after.json): the Stop window holds exactly one AUDIO_CANCEL, applied=1, with cancellation.events +1 and cancellation.duplicate_notices >= 0 (redundant copies are dropped by the transport before the callback, so they print no line); every near-witness window holds exactly as many AUDIO_CANCEL lines as its cancellation.events delta, all applied=1 (attributed and bounded); any cancel in an echo window or outside every attempt window is unattributed and fails. mechanism: Part 1: one v9 smoke part (echoear_aec_v9.run_part, mode smoke, drain allowance 4.0 s as q1) on the q1 plan with ONLY the candidate identity replaced; no reconnect and no plan injection; the unmodified qualified hold (V9Hold -> NovaHold -> BenchHold) and the unmodified part_audit over its single generation; restore 9936da45 (full boot hash), mixer byte-equal, lock released. The promotion gate policy is a Runner acoustic hook (promotion_acoustic): acoustic SCORE findings are retained in the attempt record (promotion_report_only) and an acoustic miss is passed on as ineligible, so they cannot STOP or fail the smoke; candidate faults, hard false-event findings (echo.false_turns, barge.false_interruption) and the gated flush checks stay authoritative; no v9 rule module is changed. Part 2 (only after a part-1 PASS): a separate reconnect check in its own hold, run through echoear_rollback.protected_execute (SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGALRM unwind into protected cleanup; acquisition deadline armed), echoear_rollback.AecReconnectLive with hil/plans/echoear-aec-reconnect-v1.json: the mute gate reconnect machinery on the AEC bundle, each generation audited against its own start and terminal boundaries; restore 9936da45, mixer, lock.

An alarm is allowed only if tagged with that pc_id, after that send, inside [sent + tolerance - period - early_s, sent + tolerance + margin] (2 ms slack), at most one; untagged, another peer, outside the window, a second alarm or no witnessed disconnect FAIL.
